items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a four-way equivalence making Tor independence of algebraic spaces etale-local on all three spaces and equal to the classical scheme notion (source lines 4964-5077, label lemma-tor-independent). The solver must control strict henselian local rings of fibres, prove flatness of the comparison maps, and move Tor vanishing across the base-change identity in both directions, including a prime-avoidance style image argument over affines; the reductions are not routine. Allowed background: the two Tor-independence definitions and the cited henselization and Tor lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
